adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when no existing `TopicEmbed` is found it unconditionally enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ..., embed_url: embed_url)` even for `current_user == nil` (anonymous). The job calls `TopicRetriever#retrieve`, whose only throttle (`retrieved_recently?`) is keyed by `retrieved:#{@embed_url}` (per-URL) with a 60s TTL, not per client/IP/user. Since `invalid_host?` only restricts the URL host to `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, an attacker (or any visitor from the embeddable host, and even a forged Referer header given `ensure_embeddable` relies on `request.referer`) can trigger retrieval for arbitrarily many distinct URLs on that host, causing unbounded topic creation/fetching work.
